+"""Batch sizing."""
+import os
+
+
+def read_max_tokens(default: int = 4096) -> int:
+    raw = os.environ.get("MAX_TOKENS", str(default))
+    try:
+        return max(1, int(raw))
+    except ValueError:
+        return default
